subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): scope subscription_limit blocks to the failing model

question: Should PR #99810 merge only after the WHAM additional_rate_limits selector is repaired to handle Codex limit ids such as codex_other?
rationale: The model-scoped blockedModel direction is coherent, but current head can still choose the wrong quota bucket for real Codex payloads and changes auth-provider routing for shared-profile users.

options.title: Require bucket mapping repair
options.body: Fix the selector and add codex_other-shaped regression plus real or logged WHAM payload proof before merge.

options.title: Accept exact-name matching with proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers have production evidence that current WHAM limit_name always matches the OpenClaw model id for the affected bucket.

options.title: Pause scoped blocks
options.body: Pause or close if subscription_limit blocks should remain profile-wide regardless of model identity.

recommendation.title: Require bucket mapping repair
recommendation.body: Fix the selector and add codex_other-shaped regression plus real or logged WHAM payload proof before merge.
